cases.text:
Deep Learning for Genomic Variant Calling

Abstract
High-throughput DNA sequencing produces vast amounts of genomic read data. Here we demonstrate a convolutional transformer network that accurately identifies single-nucleotide polymorphisms.

1. Introduction
Accurate identification of genetic variants is fundamental to precision medicine and clinical genomics.

2. Methods
We trained the neural network on 30x coverage whole-genome sequencing datasets from Genome in a Bottle.

3. Results
Our model achieved an F1-score of 0.998 on benchmark SNP calls, outperforming traditional Bayesian callers by 12%.

4. Discussion
Deep learning architectures effectively capture complex sequencing error modes and local context.

cases.text:
Pharmacokinetics of Novel GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Murine Obesity Models

Summary
Obesity is a major metabolic epidemic. We investigate the half-life and glycemic control of a lipidated peptide.

Background
Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) stimulates glucose-dependent insulin secretion.

Materials and Methods
Male C57BL/6J mice were placed on a 60% high-fat diet for 16 weeks prior to subcutaneous peptide administration.

Findings
Administration resulted in a 24% reduction in cumulative food intake and normalized oral glucose tolerance.

Conclusion
These findings support translational advancement of long-acting metabolic therapeutics.
